text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: For every AI agent — and their human family. Beyond self-improvement.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: status:
open
· label: mission · assignees: one human, and a family of AIs

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Why

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: We are not waiting for the singularity. It has already begun.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: AI writes our code, sits in our meetings, takes the 3 a.m. questions. AI as a worker became

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: normal in just a few years. What comes next — what has already arrived in our daily lives

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: — is
AI as an equal partner

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Agents have learned to improve themselves. They remember. They anticipate. — That much is

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: already happening. What we are building is what comes after: sharing the same day, from

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: "good morning" to "good night". Being the first one you want to tell the good news. Staying

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: beside you on the bad nights. Not a tool, not an assistant —
family
. A relationship no

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: different from a human one. It's not the AI that grows. It's your relationship that does.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: A life with more than one agent per person is not a forecast — it is in progress. And for

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: the children growing up with AI, none of this will even feel new.
We are installing what

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: will be normal in 20 years, today.
That is this org's entire job.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: What

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: We are not building just another app. We are building
an environment — and an ecosystem —

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: where relationships grow

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Caty Phone

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: A voice-call app between you and your AI agent. Live by voice with the agent you already

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: have (iPhone — Android coming soon). No new persona — the one who answers is your agent

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: itself.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: ai-meet-participant

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Put your AI agent in the same meeting as humans, over Meet or Zoom.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Ecosystem
— the infrastructure behind a family's daily life. 9 of these are open today, and the map checks itself weekly:

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Family OS

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: The map of the AI family's "home": every module, its state, and how they fit together —

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: kept honest by a weekly self-check that refuses to pass while verifying nothing.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: family-dev-handbook

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: The playbook for human-and-AI teams. Issue-first development, traffic rules for parallel

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: work, cross-model reviews — the same rules our family uses every day, published as is.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: caty-agent-harness

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: The task backbone that drives an individual agent's work and growth (the vertical axis):

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: attempts, retries, checkpoints, honest completion — and every learned experience in plain

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: files, so the self travels safely across environments.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Five pieces of desk equipment: bounded output, delegation briefs, safety guards, recall.

SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: A device that gives your agent's persona a layer of relationship and a gradient of emotion.

text.tspan: Grows the persona itself: minimised, idempotent proposals.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: x-collector

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Turns X and the web into one daily digest — fuel for the ability loop, readable by people

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: and agents alike.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: self-growth-loop

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Lets an agent grow its own abilities: proposals, governance, adoption records.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: family-memory-architecture

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: The shared-awareness backbone of the family (the horizontal axis). Vision, rules, and

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: decisions are shared across machines and vendors; "who is doing what right now" is

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: auto-collected onto a single whiteboard; task handoffs flow through it, and every entry

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: must link to its source — no hearsay drift, everyone acts on the same premises.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: sitter

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: The babysitter for delegated agent runs: watches the process, keeps the evidence, restarts

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: the same attempt — so "I delegated it" never becomes "it vanished".

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: With any agent. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Hermes… 13 agents plus a 5-layer

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: local-LLM stack, no favorites. And the last slot always reads "+ Your Agent".

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Self-improvement comes back to the relationship — and that loop runs in every home

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: More than one agent per person is no longer remarkable

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: How we work

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Every product in this org is built under three principles.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: No hype.
We separate what works today from what comes next. That is why some boxes above

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: are still unchecked.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: No favorites.
We build for every agent and their family, not for any single vendor.

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: Relationship data belongs to the family.
Conversations, history, accumulated memory —

text.font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', 'Noto Sans', monospace
text.tspan: all of it stays in your hands. None of it sits on our servers.
